subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: Bind the required PRD and tech-spec reviews to the exact version being locked (FR-16), keep reviews of intermediate rounds optional, and settle the reviewers' round protocol in the technical design (Q10).
intent: Record the approved mitigation for this exact requirement-ledger risk.
rationale: Reviewing every round of a moving draft repeats work on content that will still change. One required review of the version that locks keeps the guarantee and bounds the sessions spent.
fit_criterion: A fixture draft revised after its last review is refused until both reviews re-run on the new version, and no lock requires a review of an intermediate round.
